text:
jamal_pm: Heads-up — planning rollout for the field-splitter routing flag. Need a short canary plan + clear fallback. Thinking: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% across regions with A/B sample for quality checks.
priya_eng: SGTM. what metrics do we want for the quality side? latency, p99, token cost, and a small eval set pass rate?
ajamal_pm: yep. define pass as: no regression >1% on eval pass rate and latency < +20ms p95. also watch token cost delta.
alice_sre: Also add error budget and saturation checks. If error rate spike >0.5% or CPU/GPU saturates >85% for 10m, auto rollback.
ben_platform: flag implementation note: we can do weighted routing with a staged rollout config. example: ```json
{
  "stages": [
    {"pct": 1, "regions": ["us-west"], "duration_min": 60},
    {"pct": 5, "regions": ["us-west","eu-west"], "duration_min": 30},
    {"pct": 25, "regions": ["global"], "duration_min": 60}
  ],
  "abort_conditions": ["error_rate>0.5%","gpu_util>85%"]
}
```
jamal_pm: ben — can you set TTLs for each stage and a manual gate after 25%? want a PM signoff before full rollout.
ben_platform: yes — automatic staged progression disabled after 25%, manual confirm required.
priya_eng: For A/B: split traffic within the canary group 50/50 between variant A (old routing) and B (field-splitter). Collect sample-set of 10k queries for eval.
alice_sre: timeline? I can carve out a maintenance window for the first 1% preflight so oncall isn't surprised.
ajamal_pm: proposed schedule: tomorrow 10:00 UTC start with 1% for 60m. If green, 5% later same day. Final go on Friday if metrics stable.
ben_platform: I'll create the flag: `feat/field-splitter-routing` with stages and abort hooks. Will wire in the auto-rollback webhook to ops-bot.
ops-bot: Deploy flagged: feat/field-splitter-routing created by ben_platform. Webhook: /hooks/auto-rollback configured.
priya_eng: instrumentation checklist: add tags to traces: `splitter.variant`, `splitter.decision`, `split_fraction`. Add an aggregated metric `splitter.latency_delta` comparing to baseline.
alice_sre: set alert: pager if error_rate spike >0.5% for 5m OR latency_delta_p95 > 50ms for 10m. Otherwise slack-only.
ajamal_pm: customer-facing fallback story: if we auto-rollback, message should be: "We've temporarily reverted routing to ensure service quality — investigating" and open a support ticket for any impacted customers.
ben_platform: noting rollout knob: can force regional opt-out for sensitive tenants. I'll add a `tenant_exempt` list to the flag config.
priya_eng: test plan: unit + integration + shadow traffic run for 2 hours before any traffic steering. Shadow run logs to `canary-shadow` index.
ajamal_pm: decision: proceed with shadow run tonight; canary tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Owners: priya_eng (engineering lead), ben_platform (flag + infra), alice_sre (oncall). PM signoff required at 25%.
alice_sre: ack. I'll watch the run and pre-stage escalation path.
ben_platform: pushed the draft flag and created runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/field-splitter-canary (DM me for perms).
ajamal_pm: thanks team :thumbsup: any objections or edge cases?
priya_eng: one edge: KV-cache affinity — splitter may change cache hit patterns. we'll add a cache-warmup probe and flag a cache-miss metric. if miss rate >10% we pause.
ajamal_pm: add that to abort conditions.
ben_platform: done. aborts now: error_rate>0.5%, gpu_util>85%, cache_miss_rate>10%.
ops-bot: Reminder set: 1759999948 -> 1% canary start.
ajamal_pm: perfect. I'll post a short note to #customer-success before the 25% gate.
alice_sre: cool. logging out to prep oncall handoff.
priya_eng: will kick off shadow run in 30m.
ajamal_pm: thread closed unless something comes up. thanks.
